main_body: Seamless green ground texture patch (grass-like) filling the whole 4x3 tile area; no standing volume
top_band: none - flat ground surface seen from above, no standing object, so no top/front split applies
evidence: This is a terrain tile, not a standing object. It is a uniform ground texture with scattered light and dark clumps and no object silhouette, front face or isometric side face. The 3/4 top-plus-front contract does not apply to terrain, so nothing in it fails.

style.flat_fills_note: The mid-green base is broken up everywhere by light and dark dot clusters
style.evidence: The candidate has about five green steps: a light highlight, light-mid, base, dark and deep-green clumps. It uses no outlines, and the dark-and-light clump dots resemble the reference grass tufts. Each tile carries roughly 6-8 colours, which is at least as many as the reference grass tile, whose base area is flatter. The clump pattern repeats on a visible lattice, but the tile is clean and as rich as the reference, and it would not look thinner next to it.
